I like the idea of large subs weighted more heavily against the current limit. The limit exists as a way to keep users from having authority over more subs than they can reasonably manage, so it makes sense to take subverse size into account.

If we use a point system where every 10,000 subscribers adds a point, I would be able to manage:

  • ten small subs (under 10,000 subscribers each)
  • one large (~50,000) sub and five small (under 10,000) subs
  • two large subs (~50,000)

The numbers could be adjusted, but the general idea is that since managing a large sub takes more management time, it could be reflected in the 10 sub limit. At the same time it doesn't limit people from starting 10 small subs, or even taking on a few small subs on top of managing a large sub. It's a way to limit a mod's authority based on what they can reasonably manage, like the 10 sub limit we already have, just weighted with large subs in mind.
